item.description: Racial disparities in officer discipline complicate OPD’s push to end federal oversight A federal judge praised progress toward ‘constitutional policing’ but said the Oakland Police Department has not yet earned full independence from court supervision.

item.title: Signature gathering begins in Oakland for multi-billion-dollar transit measure
item.description: Signature gathering begins in Oakland for multi-billion-dollar transit measure If advocates gather 186,000 signatures across the Bay Area, a half-cent sales tax proposal will appear on the November ballot. Passage would mean an infusion of cash for BART, AC Transit, and other mass transit agencies.

item.title: One Oakland police officer made $490,000 in overtime. The city can’t find records detailing much of what he did
item.description: One Oakland police officer made $490,000 in overtime. The city can’t find records detailing much of what he did Overtime is a significant factor in the city’s budget crisis. But the department still can't effectively track officers' OT activities.

item.title: Oakland schools’ budget plan plunders earmarks to reduce general fund deficit
item.description: Oakland schools’ budget plan plunders earmarks to reduce general fund deficit The district’s private advisors offered a plan to shift costs, but a substantial deficit remains. Meanwhile the district is at an impasse with the teachers union, which is seeking a 14% raise.
